tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, migration and definition-store changes; Inputs and decisions 1 and 5-7; Required behavior 9 and 31 at the storage boundary; counterexample 34; Check 5, including the historical migration-5 test and startup token-import regression, and the storage/reopen portion of Check 3. In the same task, change only src/start.token-import.test.ts line 329 from { user_version: 5 } to the literal { user_version: 6 }, never deriving the expectation from SCHEMA_VERSION. In the same migration task, change the historical test "migration 5: token listing uses the token id index after upgrading version 4" in src/db.migrations.test.ts line 178 from openDb(path) to openDb(path, MIGRATIONS.slice(0, 5)). Add the separate migration-6 regression beside it, opening with MIGRATIONS.slice(0, 5), then MIGRATIONS.slice(0, 6), and expecting the literal version 6. Preserve every token-import assertion, including the refused short token, zero row counts and successful import after fixing the file. Never copy checks runtime rows into definitions or change results/incidents. Implement the SQL store in the style of token-store/audit-log, with definition ordering preserved on replacement, persisted generation and snapshot, and operations that participate in the caller's transaction. Accept only materialized definitions (no keep markers or plaintext heartbeat secrets); snapshots retain file literal headers, env references and bodies, with heartbeat digests only, as permitted by Where values may appear. Put store tests in config-db.test.ts and migration tests in db.migrations.test.ts. This is an additive persistence seam: keep the existing contract pin, live file-only routes and startup implementation unchanged until T2. T2 expands the database tests to HTTP and wires snapshot writes; this task does not introduce an alternate runtime path.

tasks.title: Admin checks use atomic database writes while file precedence and recovery stay effective
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, all Behavior bullets except the export endpoint; Required behavior 1-32, counterexamples 1-30 and 35-39; Checks 1a-1d, 2 except export, 3 and 4 except export. Pin the merged contract 2.0.0 main full SHA in package.json and bun.lock together with adapting all affected API producers/tests. Export a single-check parser that preserves the file field rules. Merge applied file order first, then unshadowed definitions in creation order, keeping a separate shadowed list and effective heartbeat digest map; runtime identity/history stay keyed by id and no shadow transition deactivates an id. Wire startup, file apply/adopt and database writes to that same effective set and in-memory holder (no SQL per admin read beyond today). Move check routes to check-write; file-only ids are read-only 409, creates collide with applied file/DB ids, shadowed PUT is 409 and shadowed DELETE is 204. Materialize markers case-insensitively only from the same database definition, retain omitted heartbeat secrets as digests, rotate explicit secrets, remove omitted headers/body, and validate the materialized check using file rules. Preserve exact statuses/order, ETag, Location, audit actions, metrics and safe messages from items 8-18. Share the writer lock; commit definition, generation +1, upsertChecks and audit in one SQLite transaction. Change service reconcile so it can join the caller transaction; publish holder/cache changes and effects only after commit. Rollback leaves every SQL row, audit entry, revision and in-memory state unchanged. Use sha256 of '<applied file revision>\n<database generation>' for the admin revision; invalid/unreadable/pending file bytes do not change it. Every committed check write advances the generation by exactly 1; every following write needs its success ETag or a freshly fetched revision, including read-only-mount counterexample 24. Preserve the full temp/pending-audit/fsync/rename/resolvePending protocol for component/window writes with admin If-Match plus applied disk-revision checks; DB-only references are 422 and a broken disk is 412 naming its state. Move existing file protocol/crash tests to components/windows. Implement file status, safe message, lastAppliedAt, retry/deduplicated logging, snapshot persistence atomically with each file reconcile, DB-before-file startup and broken/missing-file fallback; no snapshot still exits 2. Pings compare digests in constant time with unchanged public outcomes; definitions and file-heartbeat pings survive fallback/reopen. Add listening fileState/databaseChecks fields and the exact service removal log text from Contract fields. Update README and all listed docs for the behavior shipped here, including downgrade backup, the GET-edit-PUT example and file-only component/window references; keep docs-claims tests green. Record the four red regressions on baseline 2d4a6b2 before fixing them. Use temp databases/127.0.0.1:0, injected clock/reloads and typed contract-validated responses. Implement the non-export cells of the sentinel table with literal fixtures and independent node:crypto digests; T3 adds its export cells and performs the whole-change security/evidence review. If admin-created checks are already stored in the database at task start, obey the section's needs-input condition.

tasks.title: Effective checks export safely and the complete change has security and performance evidence
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, export builder/route and documentation changes; Required behavior 33-35; counterexamples 31-33; remaining export cells of Check 4; completion of Check 2 (counterexamples 1-39); Checks 6-9 and Completion evidence; the entire Security impact and Performance impact sections. Add the pure export builder and authenticated GET /admin/config/export under config-read (read or checks scope), wired to the already-effective in-memory set and applied file components/windows. Keep effective order, file precedence and env references, omit source/hasSecret/markers, remove literal headers, bodies and heartbeat secrets, convert windows to ISO UTC, and add a nonempty redacted list only when needed, in check order. Shadowed definitions never appear. Match content headers, ETag, two-space JSON and final newline exactly; query parameters are 400 and other methods 405 Allow GET, with existing feature/auth/throttle/size protections. A clean export is file-loadable; redacted exports are rejected by the unchanged strict file parser until values are restored and redacted removed. Add localhost HTTP tests with contract validators and final export sentinel assertions; do not introduce a new contract module or runtime dependency. Finish export docs and claims in the listed docs, including manual restoration with new heartbeat secrets and no import. Run the whole-repository checks, Docker/bench checks, live bun start session and review every applicable security checklist item. Gather final PR evidence including the four baseline red cases, full green checks, A/B benchmark numbers and compatibility/rollback limits. Compose E2E belongs to the dependent deploy task, whose Run A/Run B prove the complete stack; do not edit deploy from this task.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; focused coverage may be below the global threshold. Export GET is 200 for read/checks scope; a probe token is 403, any query is 400, other methods are 405 with Allow GET. Headers equal application/json; charset=utf-8, attachment; filename="checks.json", no-store and the quoted admin revision; JSON uses two spaces and ends with newline. Literal redacted fields are headers.x-token, body and secret in check order. Env names PULSE_HEADER_SENTINEL_DB_ENV and PULSE_HEADER_SENTINEL_FILE_ENV remain while literal/body/heartbeat sentinels, digests and keep keys are absent. File D appears exactly once and shadowed DB D never appears. A clean export has no redacted key and parses as a checks file; a redacted export is rejected. Responses pass validateAdminConfigExport. All cells of Check 4's response/storage table now have assertions.
